title: Readable impact effect
prompt: Complete the seed so touching ImpactTarget produces a brief, polished impact effect at the target. The effect should communicate contact clearly through a restrained combination of particles, light, scale, or color, then clean itself up.
acceptance: Touching ImpactTarget creates a visible effect named ImpactEffect in Workspace.
The effect has a clear focal point, readable contrast, and restrained visual density.
Repeated activations clean up and emit no runtime errors.
evidenceInstructions: Keep the trigger named ImpactTarget in Workspace.
Name the live effect ImpactEffect and include a ParticleEmitter named Burst.
